method.cohort: 100 generated profiles x 30 repetitions x 3 scenarios; no human participants
method.fractions: All fractions retain numerator and denominator. Pooled ratios differ from mean per-trajectory ratios reported by lab summary.
method.outcomes: budget_exhausted is a resolved failed attempt; horizon_censored is unfinished at configured eight-day horizon, not failed.
method.stopReasons: One final recorded reason per configured trajectory-day (24,000 per scenario), not every failed attempt. IMPORTANT: stop label budget_exhausted persists after a nonterminal failure if the subsequent loop exits at the daily cap. It is not a count of three-failure days. Stops can occur on a day with zero decisions; do not divide every stop count by gameplay sessions.
method.profileSubgroups: Descriptive comparisons of generated parameter strata; neither calibrated human segments nor causal parameter effects.
method.pairedFirstAttempts: Restrict to profile+repetition pairs reaching specified level under both scenarios; retain first attempt. Common-arrival selection and different paths remain.
method.teaching: Hypothetical +0.16 initial rule knowledge, 1.7x learning, 12 model seconds at U1/U11; not a shipped UI intervention.
method.rawModeledSessionMinutes: Trajectory CSV stores summed minutes over sessions. Summary meanSessionMinutes averages per-trajectory session means. Derived quantiles divide raw minutes by trajectory sessions.
method.coverage: Sequential campaign scope U1-U400; actual highest attempted levels reported separately. Held-out probe levels are separate experiments, not campaign coverage.

stopLabelAudit.inferenceBasis: CognitiveLab.run sets stop=budget_exhausted before continue; only 3 failures break directly. All published outcomes are completed, budget_exhausted or horizon_censored; no campaign cap reached. After nonterminal failure, a subsequent explicit break overrides stop. A while-condition daily-cap exit preserves it. Derived from current source, not directly logged daily actions.
